story.title: OnTrac posts new rate, AHS/LPS and area surcharge ZIP files on its rates page
story.sum: OnTrac added four PDF files to its Surcharges and rates page: 2026 rates, 2026 AHS+LPS rates, an area surcharge ZIP code list and a 2024 rates file.
story.plain: OnTrac's own Surcharges and rates page now lists four newly posted PDF files. They are a 2026 rates file, a 2026 AHS+LPS rates file, an area surcharge ZIP codes file and a 2024 rates file. The changed lines show only the file links, not the contents. The page does not state any price, fee, ZIP code or effective date in the lines reviewed. It is unclear whether the files are new documents or re-listed versions of existing ones. Shippers can open the files on OnTrac's page to compare the figures.
story.src: OnTrac Surcharges and rates (spotted by Parcel Pigeon)

story.title: OnTrac posts four rate and surcharge PDFs on its surcharges and rates page
story.sum: OnTrac's own Surcharges and rates page now lists four newly posted PDF files covering rates, AHS and LPS rates, and area surcharge ZIP codes.
story.plain: OnTrac added four file links to its Surcharges and rates page. They are a 2026 rates guide, a 2026 AHS and LPS rates document, an area surcharge ZIP code list, and a 2024 rates guide. The change record shows only the file names, so the rates, surcharge amounts and effective dates inside the documents are not known from this change.
